summary: R006 health/monitor.py fake if True implementations removed and replaced with probe-based fail-closed checks. broker/data_feed/risk_system now use injected probe functions that return critical/warning/degraded on failure/missing/exception instead of hardcoded ok.
r006_original_issue: Three core health checks (check_broker_connection, check_data_feed, check_risk_system) used hardcoded status = ok if True else critical/warning — always returning ok regardless of actual system state.
r006_fix_applied: Replaced hardcoded ternary with probe-based pattern: checks accept optional probe functions; returns ok only when probe returns True, critical/warning/degraded on False/exception/missing probe.
